watches.name: Audoin Stromlinie Blue
watches.description: Audoin Stromlinie Automatic Blue dial, no date [Sold out, new model incoming in 2027] Created and assembled by hand in Berlin, this first Audoin automatic watch is an entirely original design, created without references to existing watch cases or catalogs. There is no other watch like it. Designed as 1950s Stromlinie race car engineering, the case features air-intake–inspired openings that express motion, mechanical purpose, and performance. Every line is intentional, every surface designed from scratch. The case is CNC-milled from solid 316L stainless steel and fitted with a sapphire crystal. A screw-down crown and screw-down caseback ensure dependable water resistance and daily robustness. At its heart beats the premium Miyota 9015 automatic movement, a slim, high-beat caliber respected for its accuracy, reliability, and smooth seconds sweep. The dial features a subtle stardust effect that reveals depth and texture under changing light, complemented by fully luminescent hour, minute, and second hands for excellent legibility. Each watch is built in very small quantities, assembled entirely by a single watchmaker in Berlin. No mass production, no shortcuts — just focused craftsmanship and uncompromising design. Design Original Audoin design – no off-the-shelf case. Stardust dial finish with subtle depth and sparkle. Case 316L stainless steel case – CNC-milled for precision and durability Sapphire crystal – scratch-resistant with high optical clarity Screw-down crown for enhanced protection Screw-down caseback Water-resistant construction Dimensions Case width: 42 mm Lug-to-lug: 45 mm Case height: 10 mm Lug width: 22 mm Audoin Watch Stromlinie Dimensions Movement Miyota 9015 automatic movement. Premium Japanese caliber known for long-term reliability 28,800 vibrations per hour (4 Hz) for a smooth seconds sweep Slim profile enabling refined case proportions Hacking seconds for precise time setting Hand-winding capability Features Luminescent hour, minute & second hands for low-light legibility 22 mm steel bracelet with tool-free, easy strap removal Balanced proportions designed for everyday wear Quantities & Assembly Hand-assembled in Berlin, Germany Built entirely by a single watchmaker Produced in very limited quantities only No mass production, each watch is individually assembled and inspected

watches.name: Audoin 1st series
watches.description: Sold out, please contact the owner or follow on Instagram to know more about the upcoming Series 2! ---- From concept to final assembly, every detail of this watch is crafted by a single pair of hands—bringing together passion, precision, and high-quality materials in a piece that’s as functional as it is distinctive. Whether navigating multiple time zones or appreciating its refined craftsmanship, this is more than just a watch—it’s a testament to dedication and design. Designed for Strength, Simplicity & Precision ◇ Independent Dual Dials – Effortlessly track two time zones with an intuitive and easy-to-set design. ◇ Sapphire Crystals – Scratch-resistant and crystal-clear for lasting visibility. ◇ Luminous Hands & Markers – Ensuring easy readability in all lighting conditions. ◇ Date Window – A practical touch for everyday convenience. ◇ Japanese Quartz Movement – Precision-engineered for absolute reliability. ◇ 316L Stainless Steel Case – Strong, corrosion-resistant, and built for durability. ◇ Lightweight Yet Incredibly Tough – Designed for comfort without compromising strength. - Shipping & Delivery All watches are shipped securely from Germany. For pre-orders, please note that additional lead time is required for assembly and quality control. Estimated shipping times will be clearly stated at checkout. Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number to monitor delivery. Domestic Shipping (Germany): 2–4 business days EU Shipping: 4-8 business days International Shipping: 7-21 business days (customs costs & delays may apply) All shipments are insured and securely packaged to ensure your watch arrives in perfect condition. Returns & Exchanges If you're not satisfied with your watch, you have 14 days from the delivery date to request a return or exchange. To be eligible for a return: The watch must be unused and in its original packaging Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the buyer Refunds will be processed once the item is received and inspected Please contact us before sending anything back —we’ll guide you through the process and make it as smooth as possible.
